anchors.description: Distance between two adjacent vertical mortar joints in one course of the white sand-lime brick wall (one brick pitch).
anchors.visible_evidence: Running-bond courses of pale sand-lime bricks; per-course intensity dips give vertical joints at x=113.0 and x=153.5 within the same course band (y 411-428), pitch ~40.5 px; adjacent course joints offset by half a pitch, confirming one full brick length.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Exact brick format (200 vs 240 mm modular length) is not readable, and mild horizontal foreshortening cannot be excluded; interval covers both.

anchors.description: Outer diameter of the vertical galvanised steel scaffold tube, measured across its silhouette at y=600.
anchors.visible_evidence: Galvanised steel tubes joined by pressed clamps/couplers form the panel frame; intensity profile at y=600 shows the dark tube spanning x~634-648 against the bright panel, ~13.5 px wide.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: EN 39 scaffold tube is 48.3 mm OD but lighter 42.4 mm tube is possible; tube is only ~13 px wide so +/-1 px is ~7%, and the silhouette depth may pull slightly into the panel behind.
